options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: httpi_non_standard_ports
options.description: Servers usually send HTTP traffic on TCP port 80. Some servers send HTTP traffic on other ports also. By default, this setting is enabled and Content Awareness inspects HTTP traffic on non-standard ports. You can disable this setting and configure Content Awareness to inspect HTTP traffic only on port 80.

options.name: inspect_archives
options.description: Examine the content of archive files. For example, files with the extension .zip, .gz, .tgz, .tar.Z, .tar, .lzma, .tlz, 7z, .rar.

options.name: internal_error_fail_mode
options.description: In case of internal system error, allow or block all connections.

options.name: supported_services
options.description: Specify the services that Content Awareness inspects.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
